name: terminal
description: Run shell commands and manage foreground and background processes. Sandbox resolves filesystem access, account HOME, workspaces, and confinement. Execution is refused without a verified owner, except in explicit instance-operator direct-host mode.

configSchema.label: Limits
configSchema.hint: Output and background-process limits for shell commands.

configSchema.label: Output cap
configSchema.hint: How much stdout/stderr a foreground command returns. Past this the middle is dropped and only the beginning and the end come back, with the discarded amount named in the result. Background processes keep a rolling tail under the same byte cap and report when earlier output was dropped. Range 10–500 kB; default 60 kB.

configSchema.label: Background processes per session and account
configSchema.hint: How many background processes one session and account may keep at once; starting or detaching another is refused until one exits and is collected, or is killed. Range 1-64, default 16.
